notes: Grammar Quiz question bank. Hand-authored + independently reviewed; never generated. js/data/bbh_grammar.js is generated FROM this file.

Question shape: {id, introducedLesson, reviewThroughLesson?, type, difficulty, prompt, choices: [exactly 4 strings], correctIndex: 0-3, explanation, source: {lesson,page}|{appendix,page}, conceptTags: [..], exampleProvenance: 'textbook-fact'|'original-example'|'public-mt' (+ verseRef for public-mt), reviewStatus: 'draft'|'reviewed'}.
Cumulative gating: a question is in scope at lesson N iff introducedLesson <= N. No later-lesson grammar, vocabulary, terminology, or distractors may appear in an earlier-gated question.
Anti-giveaway rules enforced by tools/validate_bbh_grammar_data.mjs (length/position balance, category-parallel distractors, no all/none-of-the-above, etc.).
Populated in Phase 2 PR C. Empty in PR A by design.
